newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Daewoo in $60 mln Vietnam paper venture.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo in $60 mln Vietnam paper venture.

text.p: Daewoo Corp said on Tuesday that it expected to reach an agreement next month with another South Korean company and two Vietnamese partners to build a $60 million industrial packaging paper plant in Haiphong.

Country General Director Joo Sung Kim told Reuters that Daewoo would take a 55 percent share in the venture, with Shinho Paper Company, Vietnam Paper Corporation and Haiphong Paper Company sharing the rest.
He said the plant would have capacity to produce 50,000 tonnes a year of kraft paper for cement bags and other grades of industrial packing paper.

The Saigon Times Daily newspaper said the Vietnamese cement sector needed about 45,000 tonnes of paper for packaging every year, a figure which is expected to rise sharply in coming years as domestic cement production grows.
At present most of the industry's packaging paper is imported.
The daily said Vietnam Paper Corporation was also seeking partners to build a 100,000-tonnes-per-year paper mill in the central highlands.
